name: study-week
description: Plan a medical-school week: map each lecture to its study video(s) with runtimes, reserve daily Anki-review time, and stage pre-lecture study blocks into a 2-8 PM calendar window as proposed events. Emits a written plan doc + calendar events. Does not build Anki decks (that's anki-week). Ships Boards & Beyond and Med School Bootcamp video libraries; picks whichever matches your backbone resource.

interface.shortDescription: Plan the week's study time around your decks
interface.longDescription: Reads the coming week's lectures from your class calendar, reads the lecture materials to build each lecture's concept inventory, maps that inventory to the study video(s) that actually cover it — from Boards & Beyond or Med School Bootcamp, whichever library you study from — reserves a daily Anki-review block sized from your recent review volume, and packs pre-lecture study blocks into your weekday study window as real calendar events you can move or delete.
defaultPrompt: Plan my study week around the decks I just built.
Reschedule this week — I lost Tuesday evening.
